title: Desktop manifest
description: ADR-001 §6.5. A shared desktop merges its agents into ONE TRUST DOMAIN by design: within it, isolation claims are void and attribution is best-effort — and best-effort attribution is never used for security authorization or non-repudiation. desktop.input carries E whenever the desktop has external egress (effects.md §1).

shared.description: Opt-in. true means one trust domain for every agent attached to it.

resource.description: Desktop profiles and home volumes live on the desktop_data resource (effects.md §2).
